extraction.segment_function: Examine the distinctions between skilled and unskilled labor and between manual and intellectual work, tracing their historical and modern significance.

claims.claim: The distinctions between skilled and unskilled labor and between intellectual and manual work play no role in classical political economy or in Marx's work.
claims.supporting_excerpt: It is interesting to note that the distinctions between skilled and unskilled and between intellectual and manual work play no role in either classical political economy or in Marx’s work.

definitions.definition: What is bought and sold in the modern labor market as a result of the division of labor abolishing individual skill, of which each living human being possesses approximately the same amount.

distinctions.distinction: Unskilled work is a contradiction in terms, as every activity requires a certain amount of skill; the distinction notes only stages and qualities within activities rather than different activities.
Liberal arts involve prudent judgment and public relevance, whereas servile arts or trades are considered sordid and unbecoming for a full-fledged citizen.
